# Ephinea Tools

> Unofficial web tools for the PSOBB Ephinea private server (Phantasy Star Online Blue Burst).
> A mag raising planner that works backwards from your target stats, a character stat &
> equipment-effect simulator, a character overview, and an inventory/bank item browser with
> Price guide-based value estimates. All user data stays in the browser (localStorage);
> nothing is sent to a server. Every page exists in both Japanese and English.

## Pages

- [Home / data import (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/): import your character data (.psochar / .psobank binaries, or AllItems_with_slot.txt)
- [Characters (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/characters/): class, Section ID, level, stats, derived material usage and equipment for every imported character
- [Item list (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/inventory/): search all characters' inventories and banks, with PD value estimates
- [Wishlist (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/wishlist/): reverse drop-chart lookup (difficulty / Section ID / enemy / rate), PD values, and the quests the wiki recommends for hunting that enemy
- [Stat simulator (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/simulator/): class/level/mag/material/gear stat calculation with equipment & set effect breakdown, stat caps, presets
- [Mag planner (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/mag/): enter target mag stats and get the exact feeding order — which food, how many, and when to hand the mag to another character; covers evolution branching, rare mags, mag cells and the bank trick, ranked by how easy each plan is to execute
- [Reading index (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/guides/): write-ups that are not tools — separate header, cross-linked with the tools
- [Picking a Section ID (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/guides/section-id/): which ID to take on a first character versus an extra one, ranked per class, with a source on every claim; what only one ID drops and whether Red Ring is on the table are generated from the official drop charts
- [The anniversary event is changing (JA)](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/guides/anniversary/): Ephinea's anniversary event is rebuilt from 2026 (Maximum Attack E and Anniversary Badges removed, new quests and coloured tokens); covers the announcement plus what every event from 2016 onward actually was
- English versions: same paths under `/en/` — [home](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/), [characters](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/characters/), [item list](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/inventory/), [wishlist](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/wishlist/), [stat simulator](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/simulator/), [mag planner](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/mag/), [reading index](https://ephinea-pso-tools.nishimoto-learning.jp/en/guides/)

## Data sources

- Equipment, prices and technique mechanics: Ephinea PSO Wiki (https://wiki.pioneer2.net)
- Drop rates: Ephinea official drop charts (https://ephinea.pioneer2.net/drop-charts/)
- Character growth data: vanilla PSOBB
- Item values: Ephinea Price guide (https://wiki.pioneer2.net/w/Price_guide)
